product.name: Lians
product.category: Persistent project memory for AI coding tools
product.summary: Lians gives Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other compatible AI tools current project memory across sessions. Save a useful fact, decision, constraint, or work state once; Lians recalls a small relevant subset later and keeps superseded facts out of current-state answers. Local mode is free and does not require an AI account password or provider API key.

workflow.label: Connect
workflow.detail: Connect Lians to a supported AI coding tool without replacing the user's model, editor, or workflow.

workflow.label: Work normally
workflow.detail: The user saves a useful preference, fact, constraint, or decision once and continues working in the AI tools they already use.

workflow.label: Continue
workflow.detail: In a later session or compatible AI tool, Lians selects a bounded set of relevant current project context instead of replaying the full history.

workflow.label: See the proof
workflow.detail: Status and signed receipts show what context was reused, what was left out, and the estimated repeated memory tokens avoided.

surfaces.label: Lians desktop app
surfaces.detail: Guided local setup detects supported AI apps, lets the user optimize them from one screen, and opens the encrypted local control center. Consumer publication remains gated on trusted Windows and Apple signing.

surfaces.label: Bounded context engine
surfaces.detail: Stores useful context once, selects a small current subset for each task, and measures the estimated repeated memory context left out.

surfaces.label: Claude, Cursor, and Codex connections
surfaces.detail: Connects through supported plugins, hooks, rules, and MCP settings without asking for the user's AI account password or changing the underlying model.

surfaces.label: Python local library
surfaces.detail: SQLite-backed memory inside Python applications with no server, Docker container, or API key.

surfaces.label: Developer and framework integrations
surfaces.detail: MCP, Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, C, Pydantic AI, LangGraph, and other integration paths remain available behind the simple end-user product.

surfaces.label: Self-hosted service
surfaces.detail: A shared deployment path for teams that need server-backed memory, administration, and advanced controls.
